summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 5,333,331 Class A ordinary shares and warrants to purchase an equal number of shares at a combined price of $0.30 per unit, raising approximately $1.6 million in gross proceeds. The warrants are exercisable upon issuance for five years with an initial exercise price of $0.30 per share, subject to adjustment not below $0.10. The offering was conducted under Regulation S exemption to non-U.S. persons and closed on July 17, 2026. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
